items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: The interviewee does not respond to the interviewer's question about playing with Cubby Hall, instead changing the subject to Jimmy Blank. No personal connection or interaction with Cubby Hall is stated.

ctx.x: Oh, one of the last times I played in a parade was, the last parade I played was in Chicago. Elks Convention. That was the last one I played, but the last one I played was in 1925. But they had a big Elks Convention in Chicago in 47 or 48, something like that. And we got up with brass band there and played parade. They had about 40 or 50 bands. They had bands, parades, took like seven miles. Did any of them swing? And see what was guiding with us, we won't play no marches. We were just swinging. Boy, we was…
Anybody like Cubby Hall on drums? Did you ever play with them? Cubby? Yeah, I do. Or his brother? I was wondering about somebody at that.
Did you know Jimmy Blank, the piano player?
